vo: Hello everyone. This is the desktop Admin web application for the Core Committee — the full browser back office, not the phone ops app. Click Login, sign in with your committee account, and open Admin.
Overview shows pending approvals, registrations, money received and still due, unpaid or partial payments, published events, and pending memberships. Each card is a shortcut into that tool.
Click Event ops in the sidebar. Select an event to see registration counts, people, paid, partial, pending, cancelled, and check-in totals, plus money figures and exception rows for follow-up.
Click Approvals. Review pending memberships, memories, and stories. Approve or reject each item. Membership approval unlocks directory access; memories and stories publish only after approval.
Click Check-in. This is the desktop check-in workspace for venue entry — look up or confirm guests as they arrive.
Click Broadcast. Compose a short message when plans change — timing, venue notes, or urgent updates for alumni on the event experience.
Click Membership. Review applications and statuses — verified, pending, or blocked — and approve or reject applicants.
Click Events. Manage the event catalog. Open an event to edit schedule and pricing, or create a new celebration. Pricing here drives the alumni registration form.
Click Registrations. Search and filter who registered, payment status, and codes. Open a row for detail, and mark paid when Finance confirms.
Click Memories. Moderate photo submissions before they appear in the public memories gallery.
Click Stories. Moderate written stories the same way before members can read them under Stories.
Click Committee. Maintain Core Committee names and roles. What you save can appear on the public Association section.
Click Donate setup. Create and edit donation causes and review recent donations. Alumni choose from these causes on Donate to a Cause.
Click Import when you need bulk alumni data. Follow the on-screen format so rows import cleanly.
Return to Overview anytime from the sidebar. When your session ends, Log out so the shared computer is clear. Thank you for serving the Golden Jubilee. Once SFS, always SFS.
